svg.title: Coast master route — accepted runtime
svg.desc: Plan in world X/Z, tutorial and scenic anchor key, overlapping beach systems, signed curvature and elevation by distance.

g.text: First stage / 14.2 km / Pace C 1.0× / Runtime geometry sampled every 5 m
3,950–8,450 Outer mountain, rise and base alignment influence.
4,800–6,800 Beach2 road override, including its two joins.
4,600 / 5,420 Harbour and woods anchors overlap this landscape.
Other anchors and uncoloured reaches await segment definition.
Race starts at track 350 m and finishes at 14550 m.
HUD = track − 350 m. World axes have no compass registration.
Signed runtime curvature (1/m) · shaded A5/A6 · -0.0052 to 0.0090
HUD km / Short bars show authored left (violet) and right (ochre) turn windows. The curve above includes all runtime transforms.
